versionPairs.description: A compiled, code-split Bun app with EMBEDDED FILES (Bun 1.4.1, `bun build --compile --splitting --format esm --minify`, unpacked with bun-decompile): the bun-chunks app plus a lazy notes module that imports three text files (one stored as UTF-16) and one `file` asset, Claude Code's shape from 2.1.246. The linker writes each text read as the text and points the path at the tree's embedded/ copy (exp217); the split trees must print what the compiled executable printed (build/v<ver>/compiled.stdout). v1.1.0 changes the intro text (a new content-hash name) and the archive report.
